questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
Who took South Africa Women's first-ever ODI five-wicket haul, with remarkable figures of 5 for 7 against Pakistan in February 2008?
questions.explanation: Smith took 5 for 7 in 8 overs against Pakistan at Stellenbosch on 24 February 2008, South Africa's first ODI five-wicket haul.

questions.question: At which ground did J Mayes record their career-best innings (32*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Dragons?
Knights set a database record (21/22 season, List A) with a value of 344. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Knights.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 30, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/03/13.
